sentences.text:
The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceeding of Complaint Case No.6850 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC and 4 D.P. Act,
Police Station - Kokhraj, District Kaushambi pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C.-I/Judicial Magistrate, Kaushambi.
3.
Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant no.1 is husband of opposite party no.2 and applicant nos.2 and 3 are father and mother of applicant no.1.

He further submits that applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 had entered into compromise dated 22.11.2022, on the basis of that compromise proceeding under Section 125 Cr.P.C. was terminated vide order dated 10.03.2023 by the Principal Judge, Family Court, Kaushambi but in the impugned proceeding bailable warrant has been issued against the applicants though as per agreement itself opposite party no.2 will herself take adjournment in the impugned case for six months.
